annotations.title: French natural-disaster claim deadline lookup (CatNat, by INSEE commune code)

description: Use this when you need to know whether a natural disaster was officially recognised in a French commune and if there is still time to file the home-insurance claim. For 1 to 50 communes (INSEE codes): the CatNat decrees whose claim window is open and the latest decree (Journal officiel), with peril and event dates, the exact last day of the 30-day window (art. L125-2 Code des assurances; 10 days pre-2023; holiday shift apart), days left. Data: Géorisques GASPAR. For insurers, brokers, notaries. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (x402).

communes.description: 1 to 50 INSEE commune codes, comma-separated (not postal codes)

name: catnat_lookup

licence.description: Licence of the source data: nom, url, source, attribution (the credit the licence requires)

marche_a_suivre.description: How to file the claim (French), only when a window is open

date_limite_declaration.description: Last day to file the insurance claim, strict: publication date + delai_jours, no weekend/holiday extension; null when no window is known

delai_jours.description: Claim window in days: 30 for decrees published from 2023-01-01, 10 from 2003-08-29 to 2022-12-31, null before (rule of the time not read)

delai_ouvert.description: True while the strict date is not past

jours_restants.description: Days left until the strict date, 0 when closed

publication_jo.description: Journal officiel date as given by Géorisques (sometimes one day earlier than the Journal officiel itself)

report_possible_jour_chome.description: Next working day when the strict date falls on a weekend or public holiday; a tolerance, not guaranteed; null otherwise

risque.description: Peril as worded in the Journal officiel (French)
